source_name: EFFIS / Copernicus Fire Weather Index forecast
text: EFFIS Fire Weather Index peaks at 29.8 — 'high' on the EFFIS scale — at Zaragoza (stage 15) on 2026-11-19, across a 3-day forecast from 2026-11-17. 5 stage endpoint(s) reach 'high' (>= 21.3) or worse: Zaragoza (stage 15) 30, Venta de Santa Lucía (stage 17) 30, Candasnos (stage 19) 26, Bujaraloz (stage 18) 24, Fuentes de Ebro (stage 16) 22. FWI anomaly at Zaragoza is +4.9 versus the seasonal norm. Reported because: changed. Classes: low <11.2, moderate 11.2-21.3, high 21.3-38, very high 38-50, extreme 50-70, very extreme >70.
